links.outcome: AI-generated summary quality: temporal consistency, omissions of accident details versus human documentation
links.effect: Human overall 5.2 vs ChatGPT 4.5 (p<0.001); temporal inconsistencies in 14/60 (23%) evaluations; omission of accident details in 21/60 (35%).
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated frequent temporal inconsistencies (14 of 60 evaluations, 23%) and omission of relevant accident details (21 of 60 evaluations, 35%).

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing ChatGPT-4o ambient/consultation-derived documentation against human documentation across several clinical quality dimensions; it evaluates model performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
